note: Adapted from the species-level description in Maiti (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; the alate section is marked in the original as 'Based on John, 1925, Neotenic Queen', that is, described from a neotenic queen; the soldier is recorded in the original as 'Not studied', so there is no soldier section; the measurements cover only body length, head width and pronotum width.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: A rather small species: alate (after the neotenic queen) body length 8.00 mm, head width 1.03 mm, pronotum width 0.87 mm; antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 4; ocelli absent. The soldier is recorded in the original as 'Not studied'.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, thorax pale yellow, wing pads yellow, abdominal tergites pale brown, each with a white spot on either side. Head, thorax and abdomen rather densely hairy. Head narrowing anteriorly, sutures indistinct. Compound eyes medium-sized. Ocelli absent. Fontanelle rather distinct. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 4. Mandibles of the Parrhinotermes type. Pronotum narrower than the head, twice as wide as long. Measurements (mm): body length 8.00; head width 1.03; pronotum width 0.87.
